authority: PROPOSAL execution order and locked ASSET-PROMPTS K01–K03; user authorised next integration after ship journey approval
motion_use: Ship recedes behind three independently composited cloud layers; J02 enters left-to-right before ship is completely occluded; porcelain/trust follows accepted aircraft reveal.

inputs.purpose: Wide left-edge mass: broad, dense, naturally lobed volume with a softly broken inner boundary. Keep the cloud entirely inside the canvas; position its coded entry from the upper left after compositing.
inputs.prompt: One naturally irregular high-altitude cloud mass seen from directly above, pale cool white and silver-blue, realistic soft vapor edges and subtle internal volume. Isolated on a transparent canvas with large clear margins and no cut-off feathering. Consistent soft upper-left illumination, photographic aerial realism, no sky gradient, sun, aircraft, ocean, ground, text or purple/gold tones. Wide left-edge mass: broad, dense, naturally lobed volume with a softly broken inner boundary. Keep the cloud entirely inside the canvas; position its coded entry from the upper left after compositing. Match the same aerial scale, cool-white/silver-blue vapor palette and upper-left lighting across the selected set. Render only one separate cloud mass, no multi-view or contact sheet. Atmosphere retains its natural scene palette; no painted surfaces are requested. All painted carbon or graphite surfaces use Pegasoft carbon #11151B as their shared base paint color. Graphite describes the material appearance; do not introduce a separate grey-blue paint variant. Preserve the separately approved blue, brushed silver/titanium, rubber and glass material roles. Natural highlights and shadows come from lighting, not different paint colors.
